_why: Visual lane (3 Nov 2026), P2-041 / F41#17 (CPU v1/sw1 4.70 shipped, 4.56 with the 1101 Meshy arch; all three judges: 'a lone pillar on an exposed square slab, not an arch'; GPU WD2 path: 'an authored arch, two pillars and a spanning crown, seated into the moss'). Blender-built four-legged crowned arch: four stratified slate legs at +-2.15 m (outside the 2.2 x 2.5 m passage on both axes), four pointed voussoir arches, verdigris copper bands, a stone crown ring with five glowing glass points, moss-stone root feet. Reads as an arch from every approach, so the yaw question does not matter. Replaces the visible model only (stormwood_crown_arch_hero.gd via hero_landmarks_1101.gd crown_arch_overlay); collider, passage trigger, travel axis, slab and edge stones unchanged. Provenance assets/props/vl-1103/crown_arch/provenance.json. r1 judged (CPU v1/arch1, 3 Nov ~07:40 UTC; three code-blind judges, anchors f36_0_gap:C7, f36_0_npc:C4, craft; linear slope 1.51, r 0.96, RMSE 0.24, confirming batch): shipped 3.91 -> 5.92 mapped (+2.01), ON. Judges: reads as a real arch; still on the exposed square slab, stone pale and banded.

r2_candidate._why: Visual lane r2 (3 Nov), from the v1/arch1 judges: 'sits on the exposed square slab', 'pale lavender stone loses value against the purple cliff', 'banded/stripy stone'. Same arch in dark grey-blue slate with noise strata (no regular bands), darker moss and verdigris, plus broken mossy flagstones and moss stones over the 9 x 9 m landing so its square edge stops reading as a tile (crown_arch_r2.glb, source/crown_arch_r2.py). Judged (CPU v1/arch2, 3 Nov ~10:15 UTC; three code-blind judges, anchors f36_0_gap:C5, f36_0_npc:C8, craft; linear slope 0.98, r 0.65, RMSE 0.64, confirming batch): r1 5.37 -> r2 6.19 mapped (+0.82), ON. Judges: 'reads as an authored ruin', rubble softens the slab; still asks for copper/glass accents and a less square footprint.
